Thank you for your contribution! Reviewed `2170eecf094a`, including both CTA modes, mixed cluster dimensions, SF producer/consumer phases, split-K traversal and tail draining. No actionable finding. The full-cluster SF completion mask and `cluster_size / cta_group` arrival count agree with the elected issuer per CTA group; the AB barrier remains unchanged.

With a matching rebuilt extension, **22 committed SM103-template numerical cases passed on Rubin**, covering NVFP4/MXFP4, CTA1/CTA2, partial shapes, split-K and clusters up to 16 CTAs. **8 additional Rubin cases passed capture-first execution and three changed-input/SF replays**, with poisoned outputs, both FP4 formats, both CTA modes, and fixed/mixed clusters. The capture probes explicitly used the capture stream and preallocated workspace.

Local checks added **9 metadata/compile passes and 27 template/parity passes**; 25 architecture/dependency cases skipped. Integration with current develop is clean. GitHub style and the latest merge-requirements checks pass.

These results exercise the SM103 template on Rubin; I did not independently reproduce the original hang on physical SM103 hardware, run sanitizers, or measure before/after performance.
